issue.title: Ship sase v0.18.0: green CI, a floor-satisfying core, and a release wait that always closes
issue.description: sase 0.18.0 is on PyPI and `pip install sase` works again. It ships through ci_watch's guarded merge of release PR #299, after Master Gate and Full CI go green on master. The release-wait phase always closes its bead, whatever happens, so the land agent always runs. The land agent confirms the release before it lands the epic, and finishes the release itself when something unexpected blocks it.

issue.description: gate-reds: delete the stale _RunManifest import, fix the lazy-export monkeypatch pollution that empties the bare-git provider registry, chase the archive-column flake, and fix every other deterministic red on the current tip.

issue.title: Make the Full CI visual lane pass and stay clean
issue.description: visual-lane: fix the three deterministic visual failure classes (fast-startup stub vs real loader, remote rows seeded through the local loader, stale Commits description wait), regenerate only the goldens those fixes change, then prove a clean TZ=UTC full check.

issue.title: A tested release watcher that always reports and can close its bead
issue.description: release-watch-tool: add tools/release_watch, a stdlib-only, unit-tested poller. It waits on PyPI, the release PR, Full CI, Master Gate, Publish, and sase-core-rs; dispatches Full CI or Publish only by fixed rules; fails fast on unparseable reads; and on every exit path writes a verdict and can close a bead.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/v0_18_0_release.md defines phase release-watch-tool as one work unit

issue.title: Watch v0.18.0 to PyPI without editing code, then hand off
issue.description: release-wait: make no edits. Optionally cut sase-core, preflight the watcher inline, and start one monitor whose command runs tools/release_watch with --close-bead. Every outcome then closes this bead without a model turn, and the trivial follow-up only confirms the close.
